capabilities: render folder notes as table-style diagram boxes
draw arrows from link-type frontmatter properties between notes
arrange boxes manually and save positions per folder
open notes or step into subfolder boxes from the diagram
tint boxes with a color property
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later for the Bases feature. The README states it is not a full ER-diagram tool: no cardinality notation, one folder per diagram, and straight lines that can cross.
intentEvidence: Turn any folder of notes into a relationship diagram — powered entirely by Bases and your own frontmatter.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows the whole vault automatically and only that links exist, with no way to see note contents or arrange a folder's relations by hand.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's built-in graph view shows your entire vault, all the time, with no control over layout.

summary: Folder-scoped diagram view that renders notes as table-style boxes connected by arrows derived from link-type frontmatter properties, with saved manual layouts.
